payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (commit 2d82558). Sign in with Apple + Google: /auth/apple/verify, /auth/google/verify, /auth/apple/notifications. RS256 id-token verifier hand-rolled over the pure-Rust rsa crate (alg pinned to RS256 — alg=none/HS256 rejected before any crypto; no jsonwebtoken/ring), signature verified against the kid-selected JWKS key before claims, iss/aud/exp/nonce/email_verified enforced; injectable JwksProvider seam (cached reqwest in prod, FixedJwksProvider offline in tests). find-or-create keyed by provider:sub (never email), generic 401 on any failure (no oracle), unconfigured provider => 404. Adversarial SECURITY review passed clean (all 8 critical checks, exact-variant negative tests). Verified live: /auth/apple/verify returns providerNotConfigured (route merged + guard works). 25 auth tests; 748 workspace green.
